verdict.rationale: Smooth documents browser profiles that persist cookies and authentication across sessions, so you log in once and reuse that state in future tasks. It covers both the API ([smooth-docs-17], [smooth-docs-3]) and the CLI, where the agent can work with the account indefinitely after one manual login ([smooth-docs-27]). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that profiles reliably keep logins alive across runs, and detail on profile management such as creation, listing and expiry handling.
